method.clip_count: Counts playback instances in timeline and complete matched source windows, NOT nonzero audio fragments.
method.Ju: Two intended wooden impacts at 0/.095s are inside ONE AudioClip; two played clips contain four intended impacts.
method.fit: Joint least-squares mono-source gains per output stereo channel, with full source windows located by cross-correlation near logged start offsets.
method.rapid_overlap: Subtract other jointly fitted sources before measuring each clip and its energetic tail; no individual source replacement is used as final output.
method.heads: 4ms RMS >=2.5% of max, merge gaps <=12ms. A descriptive source-envelope count; event count comes from matched complete clips and timeline.
method.tail: Last 30ms before source RMS drops below 1% of its peak envelope, plus complete-source-window and ending-silence checks.
method.correlation_limit: Correlation here verifies delivery of the expected waveform; it is NOT a metric of perceptual distinguishability.
method.limits: No human listening, no Quest headset loudness/occlusion/live recognition acceptance.
